description: Trigger deployment of Flutter patient web app to staging via GitHub Actions CI/CD. TASK-6.3 (SHOW_PATIENT_WEB_LOGIN feature flag) and TASK-6.4 (Download App prompt screen) are ALREADY IMPLEMENTED in the codebase. The Flutter app at /mnt/workspace/src/moovv-fit-mobile has deploy.yml workflow with platform=web option. DO NOT manually deploy - use the workflow.
steps: Check git status and ensure working tree is clean or commit any pending changes
Push to main branch to ensure latest code is in remote: `git push origin main`
Trigger the deploy.yml workflow via GitHub CLI: `gh workflow run deploy.yml -f environment=staging -f platform=web -f upload_to_store=false`
Monitor workflow run: `gh run list --workflow=deploy.yml --limit 1` and `gh run watch`
acceptance_criteria: GitHub Actions workflow deploy.yml triggers successfully with platform=web
Flutter web app is deployed to patient path
verification: Run `gh run list --workflow=deploy.yml --limit 1` to see workflow status
Run `gh run view <run-id>` to verify successful completion
